reasons_for_inclusion: Canonical PKD primary text and his single most accessible statement of his two governing questions.
First-person source for the dictionary terms anamnesis and Logos and for the 2-3-74 cluster.
Full machine-readable text with verified line locators, so downstream prose is fully grounded.
editorial_angle: Use as the entry point to PKD's metaphysics for non-specialists, and as the primary anchor for the anamnesis and Ubik dictionary entries. Surface the 2-3-74 contradiction note rather than endorsing PKD's time theory.
curator_notes: Featured because it is load-bearing for three of the four standing research questions (what he meant, the textual evidence, and — via the Acts coincidences — what he did). Audience fit is broad; the prose should keep PKD's self-report and the editorial caution clearly separated.
